name: Tailwind Slate Classic
keywords: slate, gray, blue, neutral, tailwind, default
description: Slate gray scale with a single indigo/blue accent; vast neutral surfaces.
usage_or_notes: SaaS dashboards and marketing. #0f172a text, #64748b muted, #6366f1 accent.

name: Notion Warm Paper
keywords: notion, warm gray, paper, sepia, doc
description: Warm off-white paper background with brown-tinted grays for a document feel.
usage_or_notes: Docs, note apps, knowledge bases. Body #37352f, muted #787774, emphasize via bg not borders.

name: GitHub Dim Dark
description: Low-glare dark blue-gray surfaces with muted syntax colors, AA-compliant.
usage_or_notes: Developer tools, code sites. Bg #0d1117, border #30363d, accent #58a6ff.

name: Stripe Gradient Blue
description: Cool indigo-to-cyan gradient accents on white with crisp navy text.
usage_or_notes: Fintech landing heroes. Animate gradient subtly; never behind body text.

name: Inter Stripe Analog
keywords: portfolio, analog, film, warm neutral, creative
description: Warm sunlit neutrals, #f5f0e8 canvas, terracotta accent, film-grain texture.
usage_or_notes: Photography and film portfolios. Grain via CSS noise, 3-5% opacity.

name: Telegram Blue Pop
description: High-saturation azure on light gray with white cards and colored chat bubbles.
usage_or_notes: Chat and messaging UIs. Bubbles tinted per role; keep white space between messages.

name: Monochrome Red Signal
description: Grayscale surfaces activated by a single red accent used sparingly.
usage_or_notes: Sale banners, alerts, posters. Reserve red 5-10%; never body links.

name: Forest Sustainability
description: Deep forest greens, cream base, leaf accents and rounded natural shapes.
usage_or_notes: Eco and climate products. Green #166534, cream #fefce0; bad for finance CTAs.

name: Cyberpunk Neon Purple
description: Violet-magenta neon on near-black with electric highlights and scanlines.
usage_or_notes: Gaming, crypto, nightclubs. Add reduced-motion variant; contrast check on neon text.

name: Apple Light Minimal
description: White-to-#f5f5f7 surfaces, SF-style grays, one blue accent, huge product imagery.
usage_or_notes: Hardware-style product pages. Copy set at -0.02em tracking for large headers.

name: Midnight Ocean
keywords: ocean, deep blue, midnight, calm, dark blue
description: Deep navy layers with teal and cyan accents like abyssal water with light shafts.
usage_or_notes: Enterprise dark mode, analytics. Layer 3 navy tones for depth; teal for data series.

name: Sunrise Warm Light
keywords: sunrise, warm light, orange, peach, morning
description: Peach-to-white gradient light theme with amber accents and soft shadows.
usage_or_notes: Fitness, breakfast delivery, morning routines. Amber #f59e0b; blue links unusable.

name: Gunmetal Concrete
description: Concrete grays with gunmetal blacks and one warm highlight; architectural feel.
usage_or_notes: Architecture firms, heavy industry. 4 gray steps max; texture noise for surface.
